The Opportunity

Abbott Heart Failure (HF) delivers devices for patients living with heart failure in the areas of hemodynamic monitoring and mechanical circulatory support. Medical affairs of Abbott HF is seeking to hire a director who will join a team of medical specialists dedicated to all medical aspects of safe and effective device heart failure treatment. The director will report to the Chief Medical Officer.

The Director of Medical Affairs will provide daily business operations support related to product development and clinical research, product quality, compliance, commercial/marketing activities and customer interactions. The director assists the Chief Medical Officer in being medical representative of Abbott HF to external regulatory agencies and professional societies.

Responsibilities

  • The Medical Director

  • Provides medical input for promotional and commercial activities as requested.

  • Assists investigation teams by providing medical input as needed.

  • Provides medical support for MDR reporting when needed.
  • Provides initial medical input for quality/regulatory customer communications, technical bulletins and quality directives.
  • Engages with direct customer interactions with medical content as needed.
  • Regionally responsible for Investigator Initiated Study and Research Grant programs
  • Provides input or content to professional education activities
  • Responsible for engaging in and documenting off-label discussions
  • Assists the chief medical officer in KOL and professional society engagement
  • Provides medical input to new product development

Qualifications

An MD is strongly preferred for this role, but a PhD in a relevant area would be considered. A minimum of 5 years of clinical experience including in CV medicine would be required. A minimum of 1-2 industry experience would be preferred. Significant experience with clinical research, including interpretation and presentation would be expected. Strong presentation skills required.

The role is remote. Up to 70 % travel should be expected.

Compensation

The base pay for this position is $168,000.00 – $336,000.00

Sobre a Coty

Fundada em Paris em 1904, a Coty é uma das maiores empresas de beleza do mundo. Com portfólio de marcas consagradas em fragrâncias, maquiagens e esmaltes, cuidados com pele e corpo, a empresa atende clientes em todo o mundo e está presente em cerca de 130 países. A Coty e as suas marcas estimulam o empoderamento das pessoas para que se expressem livresmente, criando suas próprias visões de beleza; além de serem comprometidas em fomentar positivo impacto no planeta.

No Brasil, o Grupo Coty conta com aproximadamente 2,4 mil funcionários alocados em suas empresas, localizadas no Estado de São Paulo (área de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento e sede administrativa); no Estado de Goiás (fábrica Savoy e o principal centro de distribuição); e no Estado do Rio de Janeiro (centro de distribuição).

Localmente, fabricamos e comercializamos milhões de produtos todos os anos, de nossas tradicionais marcas brasileiras - como Risqué, Monange, Bozzano, Paixão, Cenoura & Bronze e outras muito conhecidas pelos brasileiros. Além disso, também comercializamos nossas fragrâncias internacionais, licenciadas de famosas marcas (Calvin Klein, Lacoste, Hugo Boss, Chloé, Burberry, Gucci, Tiffany, entre outras); e produtos de maquiagem e skincare, com Kylie Cosmetics e Kylie Skin.

Na Coty, acreditamos que hoje ninguém pode controlar ou deve ditar o que é ou não bonito. Estamos em busca de uma nova era de beleza - uma em que, juntos, a cocriamos de maneira que você possa se expressar da forma que desejar. Como companhia dessa indústria, nosso propósito é viabilizar, conjuntamente, todas as visões de beleza.

O conceito de beleza não é fixo; é algo fluido, como a água – em constante evolução e adaptação. Não é singular, e sim plural. É hora de desconstruir todos os conceitos de beleza.

Tornamos ‘fearless kindness’ ( sem medo de ser gentil, gentileza destemida ) a base dos nossos valores, porque sabemos que agora, mais do que nunca, o mundo precisa de gentileza. É um atributo e uma ação que tem um efeito de ondulação que irradia muito - gentileza para consigo mesmo, gentileza para com os outros e gentileza para com o planeta.

Portanto, hoje e todos os dias, junte-se a nós para fazer da ‘fearless kindness’ a base para suas decisões e ações; juntos, vamos causar impacto positivo no nosso próprio bem-estar mental e daqueles que nos rodeiam.

Queremos PROFISSIONAIS DIVERSOS no nosso time!

Acreditamos que vivências diferentes tornam o time vencedor. Por isso, nossas oportunidades são para todos, independentemente de raça, religião, cor, nacionalidade, idade, gênero, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, estado civil ou qualquer outra característica. Ou seja, valorizamos exatamente quem VOCÊ é!

title: Senior Director, Counsel, Legal TLM - Catalyze360 (Transactions)
description:
Overview

At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world. Lilly Catalyze360, a Division of Lilly Research Laboratories, is a comprehensive approach to enabling the early-stage biotech ecosystem, agnostic of the therapeutic area. There are four pillars: Lilly Gateway Labs, ExploR&D, Lilly Ventures and Lilly TuneLab. Learn more about Catalyze360 at:

Lilly Gateway Labs links Lilly to an entrepreneurial community fostering innovation. It provides biotech companies direct access to Lilly scientists and expertise, opportunities to collaborate on projects of mutual interest, and learning forums with Lilly experts and partners, with potential for financial investment from Lilly or venture funds. Learn more at:

ExploR&D is a drug development organization within Catalyze360 focused on catalyzing the biotechnology ecosystem. It advances investigational medicines for external sponsors with speed and efficiency and supports programs across North America, Europe, and Asia. Learn more at:

Lilly Ventures maintains relationships with life science-focused funds to gain access to emerging science, with three portfolios (Therapeutics, Technology, and Impact) and investment tools including fund partnerships and direct investments.

Lilly TuneLab provides access to AI/ML tools leveraging Lilly's drug discovery models.

Position

The successful candidate for the Senior Director, Counsel, Legal TLM - Catalyze360 (Transactions) will be a core member of Lilly’s legal team, helping drive the company’s mission and serving as a trusted advisor and leader to the Catalyze360 team. The role offers the opportunity to contribute immediately to Lilly’s growth and success. We seek a proven leader who is motivated, proactive, thrives in ambiguity, self-starting, and enjoys challenges.

Primary Responsibilities

This position provides legal support for the Lilly Gateway Labs and ExploR&D capabilities of Catalyze360 and will have the following responsibilities:

  • Lead the structuring, drafting, negotiating and counseling on transactions (including licenses and collaborations, R&D services, equity investments, divestitures and other transactions).
  • Serve as both a legal and business partner in structuring and implementing new Catalyze360 offerings and transaction models.
  • Develop agreement templates and playbooks and lead training for the Catalyze360 team.
  • Identify and resolve critical legal and business issues throughout the lifecycle of Catalyze360 agreements, including post-transaction alliance management support.
  • Partner with the Catalyze360 team and other internal stakeholders to ensure strategic alignment and support the growth of the Catalyze360 organization.
  • Exercise excellent judgment to influence and drive decision-making.
  • Cultivate and contribute to the development of a high-performance transactions legal team and a collaborative culture with colleagues in the legal department and other key functions.
  • Demonstrate a service-oriented approach to advising internal client groups.
  • Serve as a recognized source of innovative ideas in complex areas of law, business, or technology with respect to transactional matters.

Basic Requirements

  • J.D. from an ABA-accredited law school.
  • Admitted to the bar in at least one state.
  • Minimum of six (6) years of legal experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating sophisticated transactions in either a law firm or in-house, or a combination of both.
  • Significant experience drafting and negotiating complex transaction agreements in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry (including CRO and CDMO agreements).
  • Authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not sponsor work authorization or visas for this role.

Additional Skills/Preferences

  • Ability to proactively identify opportunities for creative and innovative solutions to transactional issues and process improvements.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and business judgment with the ability to influence others.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to manage internal client expectations and collaborate in cross-functional teams within a matrix environment.
  • Professional demeanor with the gravitas to lead and influence a seasoned business team.
  • Fast, nimble, and able to pivot between audiences to provide timely legal and business advice.
  • Team-oriented, collaborative, and capable of working independently.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects with priorities and deadlines.
  • Analytical and strategic with the ability to devise creative solutions to drive toward recommendations and closure.
  • Impeccable integrity and ability to handle confidential matters with discretion.
  • Ability to lead outside counsel selection and oversee legal costs.

title: Head of Sales - LATAM
description:
Who We Are

At MonetizeMore, we use AI and data to revolutionize how the advertising industry combats Invalid Traffic (IVT) and fraud. Our flagship product, Traffic Cop, is a premium solution designed to protect ad-monetized publishers and ad tech vendors from fraudulent activity. For over 15 years, our fully remote team of 100+ professionals has been driven by four core pillars: Integrity, Collaboration, Enterprising, and Kaizen. We are culture-centric, results-driven, and obsessed with building impactful, data-powered solutions.

What It’s Like Working Here

  • Actions > Talk: Execution is everything.
  • Slack & Async First: Clear, async communication is our lifeline.
  • Challenge Everything: “Why not?” is a welcome mindset.
  • Data > Ego: Bring your bold ideas—and the numbers to back them up.
  • No Titles, Just Results: Respect is earned, not granted.
  • Fail Fast, Learn Faster: Mistakes are data. We improve from them.
  • Follow Through: We do what we say—big or small.

Your Role: Head of Sales

As our Head of Sales, you’ll be responsible for defining, leading, and executing MonetizeMore’s global sales strategy. This is a high-impact leadership role for a strategic, hands-on sales expert who can build and scale a revenue engine across international markets, with a focus on high-value enterprise clients in the ad-tech space.

What You’ll Do

  • Own & Lead the Sales Function: Drive the entire sales cycle from strategy to execution—from lead generation to contract close.
  • Set the Sales Vision: Define and execute MonetizeMore’s go-to-market strategy in collaboration with the Executive Team.
  • Drive Strategic Revenue: Target and close deals with Publishers, have existing relationships and broad-based understanding around the needs of DSPs, SSPs, GCPPs, MCMs, exchanges to drive partner-led sales for Traffic Cop across LATAM.
  • Build & Scale the Sales Team: Hire, coach, and manage high-performing sales talent, building a metrics-driven sales org.
  • Act as a Player-Coach: Stay hands-on in high-stakes sales conversations and negotiations while coaching others to success.
  • Present & Educate: Deliver compelling product pitches and demos tailored to client challenges and verticals.
  • Refine the Value Proposition: Work with Marketing and Product to sharpen our messaging and positioning in a competitive market.
  • Optimize Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and hit aggressive growth targets.
  • Establish Strategic Partnerships: Identify and onboard channel partners to amplify our reach and strengthen joint go-to-market efforts.
  • Inform Product & GTM Strategy: Relay market intelligence and customer feedback to help shape our product roadmap and growth initiatives.
  • Sell with AI in Mind: Understand and articulate how our AI-powered Traffic Cop solves complex fraud and IVT issues in digital advertising—positioning its technological edge as a major differentiator in the market.

Who You Are

  • Proven Sales Leader: 7–10 years of experience in SaaS, cybersecurity, or ad-tech sales, with a minimum of 3 years in a leadership role.
  • AI Fluent: Understands AI and machine learning in digital advertising, fraud detection, or cybersecurity and can translate technical concepts into business value for enterprise clients.
  • Ad-Tech Fluent: Deep understanding of the ad-tech ecosystem—including publishers, DSPs, SSPs, and exchanges.
  • Strategic & Analytical: Uses data to inform decisions and isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo.
  • Exceptional Communicator: Clear, persuasive, and confident in high-level discussions with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Global Operator: Experience working across multiple time zones and regions, especially LATAM.
  • Self-Motivated & Results-Oriented: Takes initiative, thrives in ambiguity, and is relentless in pursuit of goals.
  • Builder & Innovator: Comfortable in startup or scale-up environments with a mindset for continuous improvement.

Why Join Us

  • 100% remote with flexible work hours.
  • Work with a highly driven, globally distributed team.
  • Be part of a fast-growing company solving meaningful problems in the ad-tech industry.
  • Opportunity to shape the sales function and leadership path in a mission-driven, data-powered company.

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)

  • Blind or low vision

Já pensou em trabalhar na maior agência de marketing digital da América Latina, atuando diretamente com grandes marcas do mercado e tendo a sua carreira e desenvolvimento acelerados através de programas de capacitação em algumas das maiores plataformas de marketing presentes no mercado? A equipe de CRM da Monks está em crescimento e adquirindo projetos maiores e mais desafiadores, expandindo sua capacidade estratégicas nos funis de conversão. Buscamos pessoas que gostam de se desenvolver, tenham aprendizado rápido e capacidade analítica, conseguindo se adaptar à realidade de cada projeto para encontrar as melhores soluções. Nessa oportunidade, você participará ativamente do atendimento de projetos de clientes, tendo suporte para seu desenvolvimento, aprendizado e crescimento de carreira, sem sair de casa, em modelo 100% home office!

O time de CRM é responsável pela diagramação e validação de e-mails responsivos em HTML, configurar disparos em ferramentas de automação de marketing, definir e criar segmentações para envios, além de participar do processo de planejamento estratégico para clientes, criando e fazendo a manutenção de réguas de e-mail. Tudo isso acompanhado da análise de resultados e KPI’s, para apresentação de resultados e sugestões de melhorias nos diversos processos relacionados à área através de relatórios.

Main responsibilities

É esperado que o perfil trabalhe dentro de um squad multidisciplinar (com suporte de liderança interna de CRM) em contato direto com o cliente, sendo responsável por implementar a estratégia de comunicação de CRM proposta pelo cliente na plataforma de CRM Insider.

Esta implementação compreenderá:

  • Operação da plataforma de CRM Insider utilizando os canais de Email, Push, SMS e Whatsapp;
  • Criação e ajustes de templates de email responsivos em HTML;
  • Criação e manutenção de segmentações para envio, com base nos dados existentes na plataforma de CRM;
  • Criação e agendamento de disparos pontuais de Email, Push, SMS e Whatsapp;
  • Criação e manutenção de réguas / jornadas / fluxos automáticos de comunicação com Email, Push, SMS e Whatsapp;
  • Mensuração de resultados das campanhas, análise de KPIs como taxas de entrega, abertura, cliques e conversão, dentre outras. Capacidade de tirar insights destes resultados para propor melhorias e otimização na operação em andamento;
  • Suporte estratégico junto ao cliente, para identificar pontos que podem ser ajustados e melhorados na estratégia proposta.

Ferramentas e metodologias a serem utilizadas no seu dia a dia:

  • Plataformas de automação de marketing e CRM, tais como Insider, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Hubspot, entre outras;
  • Ferramentas do Google como Sheets, Slides e Docs;
  • Ferramentas de comunicação interna como Slack e Google Chat;
  • Metodologias ágeis.

O que poderá ser aprendido e/ou desenvolvido:

  • Estratégias de CRM e personalização de comunicação com os clientes;
  • Gestão de campanhas de marketing digital e contato com outras áreas correlacionadas;
  • Especialização técnica na plataforma do projeto no qual for alocado.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos:

  • Experiência com operação de plataformas de CRM/Email marketing, tais como Insider, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Hubspot, entre outras;
  • Experiência e proficiência em HTML para e-mails;
  • Conhecimento em Google Analytics;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas do Google (Sheets, Apresentações e Docs);
  • Experiência em análise de resultados das campanhas de CRM: Saber analisar KPIs operacionais como taxas de entrega, abertura e cliques, bem como resultados financeiros como taxa de conversão e atingimento de metas;
  • Experiência com campanhas de Inbound e réguas de comunicação (fluxos automáticos de email, SMS, Push, Whatsapp);
  • Independência e autonomia para trabalhar em squads multidisciplinares;
  • Conhecimento em alguma linguagem de programação.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em plataforma de CRM Insider;

description:

With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for someone with a strong media and advertising foundation; well versed in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Google Campaign Manager, planning, presenting, executing, and optimizing all media strategies.

Our ideal candidate thrives on data and is adept at using it to craft the highest performing campaigns possible. Media Buying & Strategy

description:
We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

As a Landing Page Strategist, you’ll play a critical role in executing and optimizing high-performing landing pages that drive real business results across lead generation, paid media, and eCommerce campaigns.You’ll work closely with senior strategists, paid media teams, lifecycle marketers, account managers, and creatives to support the day-to-day management of our clients’ landing page programs. This includes strategic planning, copywriting, QA, stakeholder communication, A/B testing, reporting, and ongoing optimization.This is a client-facing, detail-oriented role ideal for someone with a passion for conversion strategy, digital marketing, and performance design. You’ll gain deep hands-on experience across the entire landing page lifecycle while helping execute and grow one of our most impactful service lines.

Responsibilities:

Client Execution & Project Management

  • Own the execution of landing page deliverables across strategy, copywriting, design feedback, development handoff, QA, and launch
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for internal teams and assist with client communication when needed
  • Translate paid media strategy and campaign briefs into high-converting landing page experiences
  • Work within structured workflows and project management tools (e.g., Asana) to track deliverables and meet timelines
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Paid Media, Lifecycle, Creative, and Development teams to align messaging, offers, and user experience
  • Assist in developing and refining landing page strategies that align with funnel stages and campaign goals
  • Conduct CRO audits, scroll map/click map reviews, and post-launch performance analysis to surface insights and optimizations
  • Support A/B testing strategy creation, execution, and reporting
  • Apply best practices in messaging hierarchy, user experience, and mobile-first design
  • Maintain knowledge of platform and ad network guidelines (Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, etc.)

Content & QA Support

  • Draft or refine landing page copy tailored to target personas, offers, and funnel stage
  • Review landing pages for accuracy, responsiveness, and proper integration with forms, calendars, pixels, and CRMs
  • Work with developers and creative teams to ensure pages meet quality standards prior to launch
  • Work alongside the Managing Director to operationalize best practices and document repeatable workflows
  • Help maintain and improve internal tools such as audit templates, performance trackers, and testing roadmaps
  • Contribute to ongoing training and resource development for internal teams and freelancers
  • Proactively identify areas for improvement across design, process, messaging, or reporting

Role Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO or running Landing Page projects (agency experience preferred)..
  • Portfolio of work examples with proven results
  • Experience working with Landing Page & CRM platforms: Unbounce, Hubspot, Marketo, etc
  • Experience working with design platforms like Figma
  • Experience with user behavior tools like Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, etc

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Implement AI-driven automation 50%+ of landing page workflows.
  • On-time delivery of landing page milestones (strategy, copy, QA, launch)
  • Conversion rate performance vs. benchmark or prior page
  • Number of launched landing pages per month
  • Client satisfaction and internal team feedback
  • A/B testing velocity and learnings logged

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Execute Flawlessly Across the Landing Page Lifecycle – Deliver end-to-end execution across strategy, copy, QA, and launch
  • Drive Conversion-Focused Results – Apply best practices and insights to improve performance and meet client goals
  • Collaborate Across Teams – Serve as the operational glue between Paid, Lifecycle, Creative, and Dev teams
  • Grow Through Process and Learning – Support the growth of the landing page program through repeatable systems and continuous improvement

title: Insurance Strategy Lead

Overview

Become a part of our caring community and help us put health first

Humana is a publicly traded, Fortune 50 healthcare company with a legacy of innovation, evolving from skilled nursing and hospitals to one of the largest health benefits providers in the US. At the core of this evolution is Humana’s Insurance Segment, which provides Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and other health plans to millions. By integrating insurance with care delivery through CenterWell, Humana is improving healthcare access, coordination, and affordability for its members.

Humana’s Insurance Segment Strategy team plays a pivotal role in defining the future of Humana’s Medicare and Medicaid businesses, which generate the majority of the company’s total revenue and earnings. Comprised of experienced professionals from top-tier consulting firms and leading healthcare organizations, the team works closely with senior leaders across the enterprise to drive high-profile strategy projects that address the business’s most complex challenges and biggest opportunities.

Humana is seeking an experienced team member with meaningful strategy consulting or healthcare strategy experience to join this team. As an Insurance Strategy Lead, you will directly contribute to high-impact strategy projects, engage with executive leadership, and develop actionable recommendations that shape Humana’s long-term direction. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role where your insights will help inform Board-level discussions and enterprise-wide strategic priorities.

As a Lead, you will be responsible for deconstructing complex business challenges, conducting targeted research and analysis, and developing sound, data-driven recommendations that help guide Humana’s strategic direction. Your role will be instrumental in synthesizing strategic choices being made across the business unit into cohesive, actionable plans that drive both growth and profitability while improving the health of Humana’s members. You will also help shape implementation considerations and work closely with business owners to transition strategies into execution, ensuring that recommendations translate into meaningful business impact.

Recent example projects include development of a 5-year growth strategy for Humana’s Insurance business, developing a refreshed membership acquisition strategy, identifying key go-to-market priorities, assessing the performance of strategic initiatives and business areas, evolving key facets of the Medicare Advantage growth strategy, and identifying improvement opportunities for a key business function.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to translate strategy into execution
  • Prepare executive-level presentations and materials for senior leadership and the Board of Directors

Overview

We’re looking for a UX Designer (Remote) candidate that resides in Brazil.

The UX Designer will play a key role in delivering high-quality, user-focused design solutions that support sales, marketing, and purchasing initiatives. This position is responsible for creating intuitive, engaging digital experiences and contributing visually compelling assets that align with brand objectives.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong foundation in UX principles and visual design, leveraging user research, wireframes, and prototyping to improve interfaces and optimize user journeys. They will collaborate across departments to deliver purposeful, innovative design solutions that elevate both function and form reporting to the Creative Director.

Important: While this role is open to candidates across any location in Brazil, High Tide brands do not operate or market in Brazil. This role will support our global markets in North America and Europe.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the creation of user-centered, visually engaging design strategies that enhance customer engagement and brand connection across digital platforms.
  • Translate complex concepts into clean, elegant user experiences through intuitive flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes.
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, stakeholder interviews, and competitive audits to uncover insights that inform visual design decisions.
  • Design user journeys, personas, and sitemaps that bring clarity and intention to navigation and structure.
  • Apply responsive and accessible design principles to ensure seamless experiences across all devices and audiences.
  • Collaborate with developers to ensure design intent is maintained in final implementation—no coding is required.
  • Use design analytics tools (e.g., Hotjar, Google Analytics) to evaluate user engagement and optimize visual UX outcomes.
  • Stay current with design trends, emerging tools, and UX best practices to continuously elevate digital design standards.

Web Design Responsibilities

  • Design aesthetically refined, responsive websites and digital experiences that reflect brand identity and drive user engagement.
  • Craft visually dynamic layouts, landing pages, and UI components with a focus on clarity, hierarchy, and storytelling.
  • Work closely with marketing, e-commerce, and content teams to align design with strategic goals, user needs, and brand tone.
  • Develop and maintain design systems, component libraries, and brand style guides to ensure consistency and scalability across all touchpoints.
  • Design complementary digital assets such as banners, email templates, promotional graphics, and pop-ups that support campaign objectives.

Position Overview

The Lead Engineer, Artificial Intelligence is a pivotal role responsible for driving the strategic vision and technical execution of AI platform and MLOps initiatives within the organization. This position emphasizes expertise in Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs), combined with deep knowledge of model lifecycle operations, observability, and governance. The Lead Engineer will architect and operationalize scalable AI/ML platforms, ensuring solutions are reliable, reproducible, and compliant with organizational and regulatory requirements. Success in this role requires balancing technical depth with leadership—guiding teams, fostering collaboration, and embedding operational excellence across the enterprise.

Essential Duties

Include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Lead the design and execution of AI/ML solutions across the lifecycle, including model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring, with a strong focus on reliability, cost optimization, and compliance.
  • Architect and scale CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code pipelines for ML and GenAI workloads, embedding automated testing, governance, and environment promotion practices.
  • Collaborate closely with data scientists, ML engineers, and software engineers to ensure seamless integration of models and services into production systems.

  • Implement observability frameworks to detect drift, performance regressions, and cost anomalies, and lead incident response and continuous improvement cycles.
  • Champion responsible AI practices, addressing issues of data privacy, security, and bias while ensuring alignment to regulatory standards and company policies.
  • Coach, support, and provide mentorship for team members.
  • Stay updated on advancements in AI research, MLOps practices, and AI platform technologies to guide initiatives.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning within the team.
  • Uphold company mission and values through accountability, innovation, integrity, quality, and teamwork.
  • Support and comply with the company’s Quality Management System policies and procedures.
  • Maintain regular and reliable attendance.
  • Ability to act with an inclusion mindset and model these behaviors for the organization.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field; or High School Diploma/General Education Degree and 4+ years of relevant experience as outlined in the essential duties in lieu of Bachelor’s Degree.
  • Demonstrated expertise in designing and deploying cutting-edge AI solutions that drive measurable business impact.
  • Demonstrated understanding of ethical considerations in AI systems.
  • 3+ years of project leadership experience including Agile project management, Scaled Agile Frameworks (SAFE).
  • Advanced ability working with machine learning frameworks, programming languages like Python, and cloud platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with expertise in AI/ML techniques.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading enterprise-scale MLOps initiatives.
  • Deep experience with MLflow or equivalent lifecycle platforms (tracking, registry, deployment) and Unity Catalog/feature stores.
  • Expertise in scalable serving patterns (real-time inference, batch/streaming), containerization, and GPU-optimized deployments.
  • Familiarity with GenAI delivery at scale, including Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt governance, and LLM orchestration frameworks.
  • Knowledge of cost optimization strategies for GPU/LLM workloads (e.g., quantization, batching, autoscaling).
  • Experience implementing observability and SLOs for ML/GenAI systems (drift detection, evaluation gates, incident playbooks).
  • Exposure to governance and compliance practices for ML/GenAI systems, including data lineage, access control, and privacy-by-design.

Job description

A Funcional Health Tech acredita que a saúde é o pilar principal da vida das pessoas, por isso, quebramos barreiras para promovê-la de forma sustentável.

Para realizar nosso propósito, inovamos todos os dias, unindo pessoas, tecnologia e dados para prover o ecossistema da saúde com soluções que geram eficiência e sustentabilidade em toda a cadeia.

Main responsibilities

Sua missão como Analista de Ciências de Dados será:

  • Desenvolver análises estatísticas e modelos preditivos para identificar padrões de comportamento e apoiar decisões estratégicas.
  • Estruturar hipóteses de negócio e validar estatisticamente seus impactos.

  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos modelos estatísticos e propor melhorias contínuas.

Requirements and skills

Habilidades que esperamos que você possua:

  • Formação em Estatística, Matemática Aplicada, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em análise estatística e modelagem preditiva.
  • Conhecimento sólido em estatística aplicada (testes de hipóteses, regressões, modelos probabilísticos);
  • Linguagens de programação: Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels) e R;
  • SQL para manipulação de bases de dados relacionais.

Diferenciais que vão fazer você chamar nossa atenção:

  • Experiência no setor de saúde será um diferencial (dados de operadoras, indústria farmacêutica ou varejo farmacêutico).
  • Noções de machine learning avançado e técnicas de modelagem preditiva.
  • Experiência com ambientes em nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de versionamento de código (Git).

Additional information

Como é trabalhar aqui na Funcional Health Tech:

  • Nosso time é incrível, colaboramos e fazemos juntos para ir mais longe.
  • Nossa cultura é ágil e estamos em constante evolução.
  • Incentivamos o crescimento profissional e o desenvolvimento dos nossos colaboradores com diversas ações e encontros, através de plataforma de treinamentos e webinars mensais, além da “Baratona”, que é o nosso Hackathon interno.

A Funcional reconhece que a diversidade traz benefícios para o negócio e que um ambiente plural e colaborativo é propício para a inovação acontecer. Desta forma, nossas oportunidades abraçam todos os talentos, sem distinção de cor, raça, gênero ou qualquer condição de deficiência. We are hiring one AI / LLM Engineers (1 Mid-Level) to join a small, focused team building backend features for an existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) service. As Enablement Partner within a PEO organization, you will be instrumental in empowering our Sales team with the knowledge, tools, and resources they need - when they need it - to drive sales performance and achieve revenue goals. You'll take on a range of enablement initiatives from product, process, system and skill training to content development and coaching, as we expand our offerings and grow our team.

The typical base pay range for this role nationwide is $90,000-$120,000 per year.

  • Sales Team Partnership: Act as a strategic partner to sales leaders, identifying enablement needs and delivering targeted solutions.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Legal, HR, Product, Marketing, Operations and Platform Support to ensure alignment on messaging, regulatory updates, and service offerings.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Sales Enablement, Revenue Enablement, Sales, or Sales Operations, preferably within a PEO, HR tech, or B2B sales environment.
  • Strong project management, organization, and stakeholder engagement skills, including multitasking to lead and execute multiple projects in parallel
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly articulate ideas and concepts to diverse audiences
  • Experience with enablement platforms (e.g., Seismic), CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), content management software (e.g. SharePoint).
  • Experience creating multimedia training content (video, AI, microlearning, interactive modules, etc.). using design software (e.g. Adobe Creative Cloud, Camtasia) and LMS tools.
  • Ability to translate complex concepts into simple, actionable training and content.
  • Ability to self-start and thrive in a fast-paced environment and juggle multiple initiatives
  • Ability to take ambiguous goals and turn them into execution plans
  • Data-driven mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and driving measurable business impact.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of the PEO model, including HR compliance, payroll, benefits, and risk management.
  • Experience supporting sales or retention teams in a regulated or compliance-heavy industry.
  • Experience in a sales role.
  • Experience in building enablement content to support "just in time" learning for teams with specific focus on product knowledge, sales skills and/or customer service/success skills.
  • Certification in sales methodologies (e.g., Challenger, SPIN, MEDDICC) or enablement platforms.

What Success Looks Like

  • Reduced ramp time for new hires.
  • Increased sales productivity and client retention.
  • High engagement with enablement programs and resources.
  • Strong alignment between go-to-market teams and business strategy.

Overview

Job ID: | Amazon Logistica do Brasil - F95

O SC (Sort Center) está em busca de profissionais engajados e apaixonados por inovação para ajudar a desenvolver um processo logístico de classe mundial, garantindo entregas dentro do prazo e com a máxima eficiência de custo. O objetivo da nossa equipe é operar com excelência, otimizando capacidades e monitorando em tempo real as operações do Sort Center no Brasil, realizando o acompanhamento hora a hora e fornecendo análises detalhadas dos dados operacionais.

Essa posição requer um profissional proativo e com espírito de liderança. Você representará uma posição estratégica nas operações de transporte da Amazon, enquanto trabalhamos constantemente para melhorar os níveis de serviço, a eficiência das capacidades e a otimização dos custos do Sort Center Brasil. Isso garantirá que as promessas feitas aos nossos valiosos clientes sejam cumpridas de forma consistente.

Uma pessoa especialista em operações de transporte facilita o fluxo de informações entre diferentes partes interessadas (transportadoras/hubs/armazéns) e resolve quaisquer possíveis problemas que afetem a experiência do cliente e a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, trabalhará em operações externas com relacionamento FCs / ATS Middle Mile / TOM e AMZL, garantindo que nossas capacidades sejam sempre atingidas com excelência e ainda garantindo a visibilidade dessas capacidades para as áreas parceiras e para a gerência sênior da operação.

Como especialista em transporte, você deve ser capaz de resolver problemas com agilidade, utilizando ferramentas internas e tomando decisões assertivas em tempo real. É essencial compreender os requisitos, analisar dados, identificar tendências e impulsionar a experiência do cliente sem impactar os prazos estabelecidos. Conhecimentos básicos em logística e habilidades de comunicação claras, tanto na forma escrita quanto oral, são indispensáveis. Além disso, o profissional deve propor melhorias nos processos e ter a determinação de implementá-las até a conclusão.

Essa posição estará envolvida na expansão do Sort Center no Brasil, trabalhando em turnos de 3x2. Modelo de trabalho: Presencial, em turnos pela escala 3x2. É necessário ter disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários/turnos/áreas flexíveis, incluindo fins de semana, noites e/ou feriados.

Key job responsibilities

  • Estabelecer comunicação eficiente com clientes externos (ATS Middle Mile, TOM, Time de Operações do Sort Center e AMZL) e clientes internos (centros de atendimento ROC, estações de entrega);
  • Possuir capacidade de extrair dados de vários bancos de dados (usando Excel, Access, SQL e/ou outros sistemas de gerenciamento de dados) e realizar relatórios e análises ad hoc conforme necessário é um diferencial desejável;
  • Desenvolver e/ou compreender métricas de desempenho relevantes para impulsionar os resultados do negócio;
  • Entender rapidamente o impacto das tendências nos resultados comerciais e tomar decisões com base nos dados disponíveis;
  • Encaminhar de forma estruturada problemas ou variações nas informações e dados para os proprietários e equipes relevantes, garantindo a execução de soluções;
  • Trabalhar dentro de várias restrições de tempo para atender às necessidades críticas dos negócios, mensurando e identificando as atividades realizadas;
  • Responder pelo gerenciamento de capacidade de linha e gerenciamento de volume, incluindo a realização de uploads de limites de capacidade no sistema;
  • Garantir visibilidade às atividades de Capacidades, fornecendo suporte direto ao time de operações.

A day in the life

O Sort Center é o Middle Mile (MM), uma parte da estrutura da Amazon Transportation Service (ATS), onde os pacotes são enviados para serem consolidados de diferentes origens e serem classificados e enviados ao destino para melhorar a velocidade de entrega, a ocupação do veículo e a frequência da rota. A estratégia do Sort Center para o Brasil tem como objetivo desenvolver nossa rede de transporte apoiando a expansão dos programas da AMZL, Amazon Air e Market Place.

Descrição

Descrição da vaga e responsabilidades

Precisamos de um(a) cientista de dados com domínio de Python e experiência prática em Large Language Models (LLMs) para desenvolver análises, protótipos e soluções de IA em ambiente Google Cloud Platform.

Responsabilidades

  • Explorar, limpar e preparar dados estruturados e não estruturados usando Python, Pandas, PySpark ou BigQuery.

Requisitos

  • Sólida experiência em Python para ciência de dados (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit learn).
  • Conhecimento prático de LLMs: uso de APIs, fine tuning básico, criação de prompts e avaliação de outputs.
  • Experiência em modelagem e treinamento de algoritmos clássicos de ML, feature engineering e ajuste de hiperparâmetros.
  • Boa comunicação para explicar resultados técnicos a times multidisciplinares.

Diferenciais

  • Familiaridade com Google Cloud Platform, incluindo BigQuery e Cloud Storage para dados.
  • Compute Engine: criação, configuração e otimização de instâncias (CPU/GPU).
  • Ferramentas de automação (Cloud Build, Cloud Logging/Monitoring) para CI/CD e observabilidade.
  • Proficiência em SQL para análise e modelagem de dados.
  • Git para versionamento de código e trabalho colaborativo.
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de IA generativa open source (Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, Llama Index).
  • Conhecimento de MLOps (MLFlow Registry, TFX, CI/CD para modelos).
  • Implementação de pipelines de dados/ML em Airflow ou Composer.
  • Participação em competições de ciência de dados ou publicações técnicas.
  • Noções de IA generativa multimodal (texto + imagem ou visão computacional).

title: Medical Specialist
description:
Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we're helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

Overview

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

Application : If interested, kindly share your updated resume at : ******

description:
Overview

Cargill’s size and scale allows us to make a positive impact in the world. Our purpose is to nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way. Cargill is a family company providing food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and industrial products that are vital for living. We connect farmers with markets so they can prosper. We connect customers with ingredients so they can make meals people love. And we connect families with daily essentials — from eggs to edible oils, salt to skincare, feed to alternative fuel. Our 160,000 colleagues, operating in 70 countries, make essential products that touch billions of lives each day. Join us and reach your higher purpose at Cargill. This position is in Cargill’s animal nutrition and health business, where we improve animal lives through better nutrition. Our team researches, innovates and creates solutions that deliver healthy results for our customers.

Job Purpose and Impact

The Dairy Innovation Lead (Open to Remote) will lead the vision of, and champion the product innovation pipeline and commercialization of customer solutions with technical, marketing and commercial leaders within the dairy nutrition and management space. In this role, you will identify and execute business innovation growth projects while leading, prioritizing and reporting on the innovation portfolio. You will provide industry-leading expertise to drive process improvements, and deploy the tools and metrics needed to support them while coaching and executing business innovation strategies.

Key Accountabilities

  • Partner collaboratively with relevant stakeholders to build an innovation pipeline aligned with business growth strategies and industry trends.
  • Design and lead innovation projects and independently execute development work, ensuring projects are appropriately resourced and executed.
  • Collaborate with global strategic marketing and technology, research and development and in-market dairy sales and marketing leaders to identify on-farm customer needs to develop new and existing products and solutions.
  • Provide expert thought leadership in the dairy feed and management space, using additional research and interpretation to identify issues or problems.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders and partners across the technical, marketing, commercial, and Innovation teams to drive dairy strategic initiatives.
  • Compile and analyze data for project updates to quantify success and drive accountability. Report on innovation earnings, support business case development, and deliver and manage innovation project technical expenses.
  • Ensure a safe working environment and compliance of animal welfare and product safety.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's degree in a field related to animal nutrition or animal science
  • Minimum requirement of six years of relevant work experience
  • Industry experience in dairy, feed, animal nutrition, or agriculture
  • Practical experience in basic animal nutrition, physiology and health expertise
  • Ability to travel up to 25%

Preferred Qualifications

title: Pessoa Especialista de Dados [Vaga Afirmativa para pessoas negras]
description:
Pessoa Especialista de Dados (Vaga Afirmativa para pessoas negras)

Job type: Full-time employee

Você quer trabalhar em um lugar que está transformando a educação pública do Brasil? Se imagina em um ambiente colaborativo , inovador e com um propósito que importa ? Quer fazer parte de um time que valoriza a diversidade , promove a inclusão e acredita na potência de cada pessoa?

Se respondeu sim para tudo isso, essa oportunidade é pra VOCÊ!

A Nova Escola é uma organização sem fins lucrativos e a marca mais reconhecida por educadoras e educadores da Educação Básica no Brasil. Nossa missão é fortalecer professores e professoras para transformar a educação pública e garantir que cada estudante desenvolva seu máximo potencial.

Somos mantidos pela Fundação Lemann e contamos com o apoio de parceiros como B3 Social, Microsoft, HP, Meta, Internet Society Foundation e Imaginable Futures . Essas parcerias nos ajudam e impulsionam nesse desafio de transformar a educação pública através dos educadores, promovendo ações que os apoiem a desenvolverem suas práticas, terem os melhores recursos e se informarem.

Sobre a área de Dados

A área de Dados da Nova Escola atua para organizar, analisar e disponibilizar dados que apoiem a tomada de decisões em toda a organização, com foco em aprimorar nossos processos e produtos e ampliar nosso impacto na Educação Básica. Nosso time é responsável por todo o ciclo de vida dos dados, desde a coleta e modelagem até a construção de análises, relatórios e dashboards, garantindo que diferentes áreas tenham acesso a informações confiáveis, úteis e acionáveis.

Trabalhamos em parceria com diferentes times, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e acessibilidade dos dados, e promovendo uma cultura orientada por evidências.

SUAS PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES SERÃO:

  • Trabalhar com bases de dados grandes e complexas, realizando a captura, manipulação e análise dessas informações
  • Conduzir todo o ciclo de análise de dados, da definição de requisitos à coleta, processamento, modelagem, visualização e apresentação de resultados
  • Criar e manter dashboards, relatórios e análises que apoiem a tomada de decisões e o acompanhamento dos objetivos estratégicos
  • Resolver problemas complexos e não triviais, como identificar padrões de comportamento de uso em produtos da Nova Escola, aplicando métodos analíticos avançados quando necessário
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento e o monitoramento de métricas para gerar aprendizados e insights relevantes para a organização
  • Colaborar com diferentes áreas como Produto, Tecnologia, UX, Marketing, Conteúdo, Parcerias e Liderança para entender demandas, apoiar a disponibilização de dados, aprimorar análises existentes e contribuir na avaliação de resultados
  • Fazer recomendações baseadas em dados, como análises de comportamento de usuários, apoio na definição de metas organizacionais e OKRs dos squads, além do desdobramento e monitoramento dessas metas
  • Atuar como embaixador(a) da cultura orientada por dados, contribuindo para autonomia dos times e fortalecendo esse valor na Nova Escola

Para trabalhar na área de Dados, procuramos pessoas com:

  • Formação ou experiência consolidada em áreas quantitativas, com domínio de conceitos analíticos, estatísticos e computacionais
  • Experiência prática com análise de dados em contextos reais, com atuação em exploração de grandes bases, geração de insights e apoio à tomada de decisão
  • Domínio de SQL avançado, com capacidade de explorar bases complexas e responder questões analíticas de forma eficiente
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas e ambientes em nuvem, especialmente AWS (por exemplo: Athena, S3, Glue, QuickSight)
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia em todo o ciclo de análise: desde o entendimento do problema até a entrega e comunicação dos resultados
  • Conhecimento para trabalhar com Python para análise de dados e automações
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização (QuickSight, Looker, Power BI)
  • Clareza para traduzir dados em hipóteses, descobertas e recomendações compreensíveis por diferentes públicos.

Caso você cumpra a maioria, mas não todos os requisitos para a vaga, não deixe de se candidatar. Podemos conversar para te conhecer melhor e entender se conseguimos te apoiar nas aprendizagens necessárias!

Será um diferencial se você também tiver:

  • Familiaridade com aplicações práticas de inteligência artificial e machine learning, especialmente em contextos de produto (ex: recomendação, personalização, geração de conteúdo, segmentação de usuários)
  • Visão estratégica para transformar análises em recomendações de negócio, conectando dados a decisões sobre produto, metas e experiência do usuário
  • Maturidade analítica para escolher abordagens e ferramentas adequadas a cada contexto, sabendo equilibrar complexidade, tempo e impacto nas análises
  • Interesse por Educação Básica pública e vontade de trabalhar com impacto social

Para o seu bolso e rotina

  • CLT com horário flexível
  • Participação nos Resultados (até 2 salários!)
  • Vale-refeição de R$39,71/dia útil no cartão Flash
  • Auxílio home office mensal
  • Auxílio creche para crianças até 7 anos

️Para sua saúde e bem-estar

  • Plano de saúde Amil (apartamento) com 50% para dependentes
  • Wellhub (Gympass) com acesso a academias, apps de meditação e bem-estar
  • Licenças estendidas de maternidade e paternidade

Para seu desenvolvimento

  • Apoio financeiro para cursos e formações
  • Desconto em escolas de inglês
  • Participação em eventos e trilhas de aprendizagem internas

Para recarregar as energias

  • Day off no aniversário

Faça parte do time que está transformando a Educação pública do país!

  • Step 3: Entrevista com Gente&Gestão
  • Step 4: Entrevista Técnica com Pares

Conheça a Nova Escola

A Nova Escola é um negócio social de Educação e a marca mais reconhecida por professores de Educação Básica no Brasil

Nossa missão é fortalecer educadores para transformar a Educação pública brasileira e possibilitar que os alunos desenvolvam o máximo do seu potencial.

Desenvolvemos produtos, serviços e conteúdos que valorizam os professores, facilitam seu dia-a-dia e apoiam sua carreira. Nosso principal mantenedor é a Fundação Lemann e realizamos parcerias com diversas organizações como Google.org, Facebook, Fundação Itaú Social, Imaginable Futures, Governo Britânico, secretarias de educação e outras organizações que nos ajudam nesse desafio.

64% dos professores brasileiros utilizam nossos planos de aula todos os meses, além disso temos 3 milhões de visitantes únicos por mês em nossa plataforma e cerca de 1,8 milhões de seguidores em nossas redes sociais, o que nos permite conhecer bem nosso público.

Valorizamos a diversidade no ambiente de trabalho e estamos buscando tornar a Nova Escola ainda mais diversa. As nossas vagas são destinadas a todos!

Trabalhamos com

O Educador no centro: Para nós, a transformação acontece através das professoras e professores de escola pública. Sentimos orgulho das nossas soluções serem baseadas em dados e evidências, desenvolvidas a partir e junto daqueles que vivenciam diariamente a realidade da educação pública brasileira. Estamos unidos com os professores por uma causa comum: oferecer um ensino de qualidade para todos os alunos do nosso país.

Autonomia para ir além: Somos inquietos, dispostos a arriscar, dialogar e reinventar. Criamos novos formatos, melhoramos os existentes, mantendo o foco nos educadores. Assumimos riscos, testamos novas soluções, aprendemos com os erros e medimos nosso impacto. Com essa confiança e autonomia, podemos concentrar nossos esforços no propósito que nos move.

Busca pela Excelência: Nosso time está comprometido a buscar a excelência em tudo que faz para atingir a missão da Nova Escola. Exigimos de nós mesmos um trabalho de qualidade e melhoria contínua. Procuramos, a partir de nossas especialidades, aprender continuamente sobre a Educação Pública.

Juntos e Diversos: Para nós, a diversidade, a inclusão e os conhecimentos multidisciplinares são pilares fundamentais para as nossas práticas, tanto nas ações que desenvolvemos com/para os educadores do Brasil quanto em iniciativas internas. Acreditamos que pessoas com diferentes trajetórias e pontos de vista se complementam e podem compartilhar um mesmo propósito. Pensamos juntos para pensar maior.

Atitude Responsável: Para nós, agir com responsabilidade é uma prática contínua, tanto no trabalho quanto na vida. Gerenciamos pessoas, parceiros e recursos para desenvolver soluções que geram impacto na educação. Mantemos uma atitude ética, respeitosa, acolhedora e proativa para inspirar uma mudança na sociedade. Nossa atuação é suprapartidária e livre de interesses pessoais na sociedade.

Diálogo transparente: Promovemos um ambiente onde todos se sentem à vontade para fazer perguntas e buscar esclarecimentos abertamente. Incentivamos a comunicação direta e transparente e valorizamos o diálogo produtivo. Acreditamos que a coragem para expressar dúvidas e compartilhar ideias fortalece nossa colaboração e aprimora nossos processos.

title: Network Manager
description:
Overview

Who We Are

Ready to create a healthier world? We are ready for you! Personify Health is on a mission to simplify and personalize the health experience to improve health and reduce costs for companies and their people. At Personify Health, we believe in offering total rewards, flexible opportunities, and a diverse inclusive community, where every voice matters. Together, we’re shaping a healthier, more engaged future.

Responsibilities

Ready to Drive Excellence Across Diverse Network Partnerships?

We're seeking a strategic operational leader who can manage the ongoing performance of our diverse portfolio of leased carrier networks while serving as a direct extension of the Director of Network Management. As our Network Manager, you'll ensure internal operational excellence while supporting the strategic success of our network products, including leased networks and COE partners.

What makes this role different

  • Portfolio management: Oversee diverse network partnerships including secondary, regional, and dental networks with comprehensive performance monitoring
  • Strategic insights: Develop performance dashboards that deliver actionable insights driving business decisions for leadership and client account teams
  • Cross-functional impact: Collaborate with Claims Operations, Clinical teams, and Commercial teams to ensure operational alignment and excellence
  • Implementation leadership: Support GTM new network implementation with project management expertise and operational readiness coordination

What You'll Actually Do

  • Drive network performance excellence: Report on network performance focusing on KPIs including performance guarantees, client and membership growth, network revenue, product utilization, and quality outcomes.
  • Maintain operational oversight: Develop network management documentation, prepare internal updates, manage contracts, and serve as primary contact for operational issues and processes.
  • Monitor compliance rigorously: Track performance guarantees for all networks, ensure accurate delivery of network scorecards, and review data for ongoing compliance with membership growth targets and claims timeliness.
  • Resolve complex escalations: Lead research and resolution of service requests including complex client escalations related to network issues while collaborating with networks on training coordination.
  • Support strategic initiatives: Provide GTM new network implementation support, organize network notifications processes, and contribute to strategic development of network management capabilities.
  • Enable internal teams: Support Claims Operations by providing clarity on unique operational and contractual nuances of each network while building collaborative relationships with Commercial and Operations Enablement teams.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Mission

  • The operational foundation:
    • Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or related field (equivalent work experience considered)
    • 2-4 years experience in provider network management, provider relations, or healthcare operations
    • Experience within TPA, health plan, or health system environment
  • The analytical expertise:
    • Demonstrated experience with different provider reimbursement models including fee-for-service
    • Understanding of value-based care concepts (ACOs, Clinically Integrated Networks)
    • Proven ability to analyze healthcare data (claims, provider, network, eligibility) to identify trends and solve problems
  • The professional competencies:
    • Relationship building: Natural ability to build rapport and establish trust with clients, providers, and internal colleagues
    • Analytical mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with talent for translating complex data into clear, actionable insights
    • Project management: Outstanding organizational skills with ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities effectively
    • Communication excellence: Exceptional written and verbal skills for presenting information clearly to diverse audiences
    • Autonomy and initiative: Self-starter who can work independently, take ownership of projects, and navigate ambiguity in dynamic environments
    • Technical proficiency: Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel) with comfort learning new claims and provider management software

Why You'll Love It Here

We believe in total rewards that actually matter—not just competitive packages, but benefits that support how you want to live and work.

Your wellbeing and Benefits

  • Your wellbeing comes first: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build!)
  • Mental health support and wellness programs designed by experts who get it
  • Flexible work arrangements that fit your life, not the other way around
  • Financial security that makes sense: Retirement planning support to help you build real wealth for the future
  • Basic Life and AD&D Insurance plus Short-Term and Long-Term Disability protection
  • Employee savings programs and voluntary benefits like Critical Illness and Hospital Indemnity coverage
  • Growth without limits: Professional development opportunities and clear career progression paths
  • Mentorship from industry leaders who want to see you succeed
  • Learning budget to invest in skills that matter to your future

A culture that energizes

  • People Matter: Inclusive community where every voice matters and diverse perspectives drive innovation
  • One Team One Dream: Collaborative environment where we celebrate wins together and support each other through challenges
  • We Deliver: Mission-driven work that creates real impact on people's health and wellbeing, with clear accountability for results
  • Grow Forward: Continuous learning mindset with team events, recognition programs, and celebrations that make work genuinely enjoyable

The practical stuff

  • Competitive base salary plus bonus structure that rewards your success
  • Unlimited PTO policy because rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
  • Benefits effective day one—because you shouldn’t have to wait to be taken care of

Ready to create a healthier world? We're ready for you.

No candidate will meet every single qualification listed. If your experience looks different but you think you can bring value to this role, we'd love to learn more about you.

Personify Health is an equal opportunity organization and is committed to diversity, inclusion, equity, and social justice.

In compliance with all states and cities that require transparency of pay, the base compensation for this position ranges from $100,000 to $120,000. Note that compensation may vary based on location, skills, and experience. This position is eligible for 10% target bonus/variable compensation as well as health, dental, vision, mental health and other benefits.

We strive to cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive. Personify Health is committed to driving Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) for all stakeholders: employees (at each organization level), members, clients and the communities in which we operate. Diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

#WeAreHiring #PersonifyHealth

Beware of Hiring Scams: Personify Health will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information such as social security numbers during the hiring process. All official communication will come from a verified company email address. title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 3.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus. We’ve raised nearly $400M in funding—including the largest Series A in fintech history—and just closed our Series B to fuel our next stage of hypergrowth.

We are seeking a skilled and driven Senior Application Security Engineer to join Rain’s growing Security team. This role demands a proactive approach to secure software development and cloud-native defense. You will partner closely with engineering and development squads, and work alongside our Cloud Security and GRC team members to improve Rain’s application and platform security posture. This position is technically grounded, requiring direct engagement in application-layer matters and security reviews, while also contributing to cloud security automation, awareness initiatives, and secure engineering practices across the SDLC.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with development squads to validate vulnerabilities and provide actionable remediation guidance aligned with business risk.
  • Drive threat modeling sessions (e.g., STRIDE, PASTA) for critical systems and APIs.
  • Design, implement, and oversee automated processes for securely updating application and code dependencies, proactively mitigating issues and ensuring timely vulnerability remediation.
  • Integrate security checks into CI / CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC), working with tools like Semgrep, Snyk, Trivy, and Burp Suite.
  • Contribute to runtime security initiatives, such as container / Kubernetes hardening, RASP, and eBPF-based detection.
  • Build and maintain a security issues dashboard to track remediation status and metrics.
  • Provide real-time support in the event of cybersecurity incidents impacting applications or cloud infrastructure (exploited vuln, credential stuffing, web / API attacks).
  • Partner with the Cloud Security team on security automation tasks and monitoring improvements (e.g., Security Hub remediation automations, DLP monitoring, etc.).
  • Conduct proactive research on new threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques relevant to Rain’s architecture.
  • Collaborate with the GRC team to develop and deliver internal security awareness initiatives, phishing campaigns, and developer training (e.g., secure coding, API security).
  • Participate in the continuous improvement of AppSec maturity (e.g., aligning with OWASP SAMM, ISO 27001, or SOC 2 frameworks).

Required Qualifications

  • Fluent English, including strong verbal and written skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills to convey security risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing roles, and/or secure code development, including work with QA teams.
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, and SCA tools (e.g., Semgrep, Burp, Snyk).
  • Deep understanding of web, mobile, and API vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, API Top 10, MITRE CWE).
